sql: with f as (select fl.kalshi_order_id, fl.market_ticker, min(fl.filled_at) as filled_at, sum(fl.quantity) as qty from fills fl group by 1,2), o as (select lo.id, lo.kalshi_order_id, lo.strategy, lo.market_ticker, lo.created_at, lo.limit_price from live_orders lo where lo.strategy ilike '%mmsell%' and lo.side='no' and lo.action='buy' and lo.limit_price between 90 and 95 and split_part(lo.market_ticker,'-',1) in ('KXFEDMENTION','KXINX','KXINXU','KXNASDAQ100U','KXRAIN','KXTRUMPSAY','KXWCMENTION')), p as (select distinct on (market_ticker) market_ticker, realized_pnl, coalesce(quantity_fp,quantity) as pos from positions order by market_ticker, captured_at desc), q0 as (select distinct on (live_order_id) live_order_id, contracts_ahead, queue_position from live_order_queue_ticks order by live_order_id, captured_at) select split_part(o.market_ticker,'-',1) as series, o.strategy, o.market_ticker, o.limit_price as px, round(extract(epoch from (f.filled_at - coalesce(c.submitted_at,o.created_at)))/60.0) as wait_min, c.hot_entry as hot, c.spread, c.depth_at_best_bid as dbid, c.depth_at_best_ask as dask, c.market_volume as vol, round(c.hours_to_close::numeric,1) as htc, q0.contracts_ahead as ahead0, extract(hour from (coalesce(c.submitted_at,o.created_at) at time zone 'America/New_York')) as hr_et, case when p.pos=0 then (p.realized_pnl<0)::int end as lost from o join f on f.kalshi_order_id=o.kalshi_order_id left join execution_order_context c on c.live_order_id=o.id left join p on p.market_ticker=o.market_ticker left join q0 on q0.live_order_id=o.id order by wait_min
